display_long_description:
BECOME THE MONSTER is an asymmetric multiplayer VR horror game. Each round, one player is the monster and hunts the survivors. The survivors have to stay alive and fight back.

PLAY THE MONSTER
Pick your monster and move with your own body. Swing your arms to run faster, and use your hands and your size to catch and kill. Each monster plays differently:

Hush: a silent stalker that picks off survivors from a distance.
Harvestman: a fast, long-limbed hunter that can jump.
HussDemon: a very fast demon with legs and no arms. It rams players down.

PLAY THE SURVIVOR
Work together and watch each other’s backs. Grab weapons, reload them by hand and fight the monster off before it finds you.

FULL VR, FULL BODY
Everything is done with your hands in VR: grabbing, aiming, reloading and swinging your arms to move.

TALK TO EACH OTHER
Proximity voice chat lets you hear the people around you. Warn your friends, or listen for the monster.

KILL REPLAYS
After each round, the kills from that round play back for everyone, so you can see what happened.

EARN AND CUSTOMIZE
Win rounds to earn coins. Spend them in the shop on new characters, and climb the leaderboards.

SWITCH SERVERS
If a server is full, use the server switch in the lobby to join another one.

This game contains graphic violence and gore. It is for mature players only.
